intro: Mannoroc Coven is a demon-infested ruin in southern Desolace, named after the pit lord Mannoroth. Settled among ancient night elf architecture, it stands as the largest stronghold of the Burning Legion in central Kalimdor. Cultists of the Burning Blade maintain active summoning portals here, filling the ash-choked land with felhounds, succubi, and infernals.

p: Situated south of Ghost Walker Post and east of Shadowprey Village, Mannoroc Coven blankets the ancient night elf ruins in an oppressive, fel-tainted pall. The coven is commanded on the ground by Lord Azrethoc, alongside the Burning Blade warlock Jugkar Grim'rod. Together, they harness active summoning portals to pull demonic reinforcements straight into Kalimdor, including doomguards, infernals, and felhounds. Even as Horde-aligned travelers attempt to sever these links using relics like the Hand of Iruxos, new rifts continue to tear open through the scarred earth.
